title: Modport Direction Conflict — Grant Net Multi-Driven
bug_signature: VCS-ERROR: Multi-driver conflict on net 'gnt'; driven by both u_arb and u_mon
expected_root_cause: Both the arbiter and bus_monitor modules are instantiated with the master modport direction; both modules attempt to drive the gnt net simultaneously, producing a multi-driver conflict that forces the net to X.
description: Two modules both use a `master` modport and both drive `gnt`, causing a multi-driver conflict that results in X on the grant net.
failure_log: VCS-ERROR: Multi-driver conflict on net 'gnt'; driven by both u_arb and u_mon
success_log: Single driver on gnt. No multi-driver warnings.
